title: Independent critique B - data availability, leakage, statistical design, implementation fidelity, overfitting

assigned_to.note: Reviewer B must not see Reviewer A's review or the synthesis. Its first review is independent of both, and it reviews the same evidence as A.

review_object.what: The complete proposed logic for the USD session engine: all twenty-five briefs and the cards they return - the fifteen session-research cards from A1 and A2, and the ten baseline-audit cards for the deployed factors F1 to F10 from the handoff bundle packs under docs/research/handoff/usd/v1/packs/ - plus the master specification produced by synthesis, the frozen evaluation design, and this coordinator's own dataset and experiment plan
inputs: docs/research/handoff/usd/v1/packs/ (one brief per factor, twenty-five of them) and docs/research/handoff/usd/v1/BRIEF_INDEX.json
data/usd-24h-dataset-manifest.json and data/usd-24h-research-dataset.json (the available data, read-only)

review_focus: Can each card's stated inputs actually be obtained for the claimed history, at the frequency claimed, with the timing claimed?
Is there any look-ahead: a value that in reality became known after the 05:00 London cutoff, a revision used as if it were the first print, a session bar that closed after the endpoint?
Is the statistical design sound: frozen target, eligibility, missing-quote policy, holidays, ties, splits, scoring, uncertainty and multiple-comparison accounting?

How many independent comparisons does the design actually buy once the overlaps across all twenty-five cards are counted? The twenty-five briefs read the same handful of series, so say which cards would be tested against the same series, which of them cannot be separated by any test the design allows, and which single member of each overlapping group you would keep.
Is the implementation faithful to the stated rule, and is LLM discretion eliminated from the numeric path?
Where could overfitting enter: parameter grids, threshold searches, factor selection, or a holdout already spent?
Does any claimed result come from the numerical harness rather than from narrative?

per_issue: the concrete objection in one paragraph
the evidence or reasoning that supports it
a falsifiable test that would confirm or refute it
also_required: an explicit statement of which cards are data-blocked today
an approval or rejection of the frozen evaluation design before any candidate is scored

rules: Reviewer B's approval of the evaluation design is a gate: no candidate scoring happens before it or before the coordinator records why it is unavailable.
State plainly when a test cannot be run with the data that exists, rather than proposing a design that requires data no one can obtain.
Agreement between models is not evidence of predictive value, and this review must not present it as such.
No production, workflow, dashboard or configuration change is authorised by this review.
